quest.title: Let the Bloomflower Trials Begin!
quest.description: The Pyro Archon, Mavuika, has agreed to hold the Bloomflower Trials, and the competition venue is ready. All that's left is to sign up for it...

dialogues.speaker: Ballo
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon! We meet at last.

dialogues.speaker: Ballo
dialogues.text: Welcome to the Bloomflower Trials! I heard from our chief that you're here to sign up for the competition?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah! But we were wondering, what exactly are the Bloomflower Trials about?

dialogues.speaker: Ballo
dialogues.text: Ah, I'll give you a quick rundown.

dialogues.speaker: Ballo
dialogues.text: First of all, the Bloomflower Trials are divided into "Offensive Battles" and "Defensive Battles."

dialogues.speaker: Ballo
dialogues.text: Defensive battles are simple, just stop your opponents from attacking the tribe. Playing offense is trickier. Assuming your tribe's lost its defense, they have to sound a horn and counterattack.

dialogues.speaker: Ballo
dialogues.text: To spice things up, we've added special ritual items into the mix. Attackers can charge them up to destroy the defenders' special barriers.

dialogues.speaker: Ballo
dialogues.text: And even if this is a competition, we don't want to see uncalled-for violence or conflicts. Anything broken should be fixed, and if you see monsters, please clear them out.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa... Paimon's head is spinning. {NICKNAME}, did you catch all that?

response.speaker: Ballo
response.text: Don't sweat it! If you've got questions, come find me. The competition isn't that complicated, I'm sure you'll get the hang of it in no time if you participate.

choices.text: Um... Definitely one of the quick rundowns of all time.
